drivingQuestion: Why do the Rabbis permit it?

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ מַאי טַעְמַיְיהוּ דְּרַבָּנַן? דַּאֲמַר לֵיהּ: אֲנָא מְפַלֵּיגְנָא אַמְגּוֹזֵי, וְאַתְּ פַּלֵּיג שִׁיסְקֵי.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara asks: «What is the reason for the» opinion of «the Rabbis,» who permit the free distribution of toasted grain and nuts? It is «because» the storekeeper can «say to his» competitors: «I hand out nuts; and you hand out jujubes [shiskei].» All merchants are able to hand out goods that will attract children, and consequently this is not unfair competition.
